_provenance.warning: These are SELF-GENERATED. Unlike the X-Wing and ML-DSA vectors in this directory, no third party publishes vectors for atPQv1-base, because it is an Atsign-internal construction. They are a conformance CONTRACT between implementations, not outside attestation: they prove that at_chops and any other implementation agree byte-for-byte, and nothing more. The primitives underneath are separately checked against RFC 5869, RFC 4231 and McGrew-Viega.
